dockets.what_it_says: Appalachian Power asks the SCC to let it charge customers for developing a site for a potential small modular reactor at its Joshua Falls property in Campbell County. It expects site development to cost about $100 million, financed over six years; the first year would recover $20.6 million through bills from October 2027 through September 2028. A 2024 state law caps recovery at $125 million. The article (5 November 2026) does not give the filing date or case number.
dockets.microreactor_read: Ratepayers would fund SMR site studies and permits years before a reactor exists; the utility says one would likely not run until the mid- to late 2030s. The SCC's own staff raised, in a related 2025 proceeding, the risk of customers paying for a site that is never built.
